evidence: Template library grid shows 6 templates, each with author (e.g. Sarah Chen), description, category/scenario tags, use count, and update date.
Clicking "Use Template" on Professional Resume card opened a dialog with Fill Template/Preview Result tabs for that template.
Filled all form fields (Full Name, Job Title, Email, etc.) via browser_fill_form; values persisted in the fields.
After filling required fields, "Preview Result" tab became enabled and displayed the generated resume content.
Each card shows template name (heading), author, description, type/category tag, and "Updated <date>".

Preview rendered correct Markdown structure matching filled data: Name as H1, title/contact line, Professional Summary, Experience, Education, Skills sections with all entered values reflected accurately.
Category filter (Resume) reduced to 1/6 templates; Scenario filter (Academic) reduced to 1/6; Sort By "Recently Updated" reordered templates correctly by date descending (2024-12-05 first).
Clicking heart icon on Professional Resume card toggled favorite state (button style + icon fill changed), and Favorites counter badge updated to "1".
Clicking "Favorites" button filtered the grid to show only the favorited "Professional Resume" template (Showing 1 of 6 templates); combined with search it further filtered correctly.
Clicking "Copy to Clipboard" on Preview Result tab produced a toast: "Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied."
Typing "Resume" in search box produced a live suggestion dropdown listing "Professional Resume" as a fuzzy/keyword match.

Before filling required fields, "Preview Result" tab was disabled and an alert "Required fields missing" listed missing fields; after all required fields were filled, the tab became enabled and preview was generated.
Alert box "Required fields missing" with red/warning icon and list of missing fields displayed while required fields empty; disappeared and Preview tab enabled once satisfied.
After clicking heart button, its class changed from default to "bg-primary/10 text-primary" and the heart svg gained "fill-current" class, providing visible color/fill feedback.
Preview rendered proper headings, bold/italic emphasis, and paragraphs matching the input data without malformed markdown or broken formatting.

actual: Typing "John@#$%Doe" into the required "Full Name" field was accepted verbatim with no filtering, error message, or "Special characters are prohibited" warning.

issue: No visual feedback for special character input
actual: Entering special characters (@#$%) into the Full Name field produced no visual feedback (no error styling, no toast, no blocked input); characters were simply accepted.
Entering "not-a-date" into the required "Start Date" field (and "also-not-a-date" into End Date) was accepted without any validation error; fields are free text with no date format enforcement.
Set Start Date="Jan 2025" and End Date="Jan 2020" (start after end); no validation error or warning appeared, form did not block this input.

issue: Suggestion click does not redirect to template
actual: Real-time suggestions do appear while typing, but clicking a suggestion ("Professional Resume") only filled the search box with that text and filtered the grid to show it; it did not open/redirect to the template's detail/fill dialog.

evidence: Filled Submit Template form (Title, Author, Description, Markdown Content with {{fieldName}} placeholders, and defined a "Name" field) and clicked Submit Template; received toast "Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library."
After submission, template count increased from 6 to 7 and "QA Test Template" appeared in the public library grid with author "QA Tester", description, category, 0 uses, and today's update date.
Immediately after submission (no reload), the library list updated in real time to show 7 of 7 templates including the newly submitted "QA Test Template", staying in sync with the grid view.

Clicking Submit Template with all required fields (Title, Author, Description, Content) empty produced toast "Missing required fields - Please fill in all required fields." and the dialog remained open without submitting.
Typing "Weekly" character by character into the search box progressively filtered the grid in real time down to "Showing 1 of 6 templates" without any submit action.

issue: No Markdown syntax validation on submission
actual: Submitted a template with deliberately malformed Markdown (unclosed code fence, unclosed bold marker, broken link syntax, malformed table) and it was accepted without any warning — toast showed "Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library." and it appeared in the library as "Broken Markdown Test".
